description.value:
Frequency once per character level

Requirement You have the Marrow Deep feat.

Cost 3 Vitae

You may perform Marrow Deep's procedure on a willing ally instead of yourself: choose one minor beneficial mutation from the Bloom Table's Runaway Mutation entries the GM has approved, or propose a comparable one with the GM, and graft it into them permanently. It doesn't require maintenance. This draws from the same once-per-level limit as using Marrow Deep on yourself — the two don't stack into two uses in the same level.

cinderfall.incomplete: This card's entire payload is a Vitae-spend/gain beyond the bare pool, a Bloom Table roll/choice, Resonance, Load, Strain, or "Mk" grade -- none of which has any rule-element representation anywhere in this corpus. fleshmancer.vitae-pool.json's own SpecialResource (slug: vitae, max: 10, renew: false) only declares the bare pool; its schema (value, max, itemUUID, level, renew) has no field for a per-source gain/spend/reroll/choose trigger, so every Vitae-cost/-gain clause on every other card is inert as far as system.rules is concerned, and Bloom/Resonance/Load/Strain have no representation at all. Also This effect changes a different creature's own roll, HP, condition, or item, sourced from the card holder's own passive/item/action. No selector exists anywhere in pf2e-source for this -- confirmed corpus-wide this pass. Depends explicitly on fleshmancer.marrow-deep.json, itself rules: [].
